source_caption_text:
Bro turned into an Arab mid song

“Only You Freestyle” is a standout collaboration between Headie One and Drake, released in 2020 as the lead single from Headie One’s debut album, *Edna*. The track became a landmark moment by bringing one of the UK’s biggest drill artists together with one of hip-hop’s biggest global stars.

Produced by M1onthebeat, the song pairs dark, atmospheric production with confident performances from both artists. Drake embraces the UK drill style on the opening verse, while Headie One follows with his distinctive flow and delivery, creating a collaboration that feels natural and energetic.

The accompanying music video matched the song’s stripped-back aesthetic and helped fuel conversation online following its release. Years later, “Only You Freestyle” remains an important crossover record that introduced UK drill to an even wider international audience.
